runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
The memorandum applies to new AI contracts **180 days after it is issued**. Its coverage is keyed to the solicitation date: contracts awarded under solicitations issued on or after that 180-day mark fall within it, as do options to renew or extend an existing contract exercised after that date.

The memorandum has one main exclusion. It does not reach AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
